items.title: More questions about whether researchers can trust OpenAI with unpublished math
items.author: pred_
items.summary: Researchers question if they can trust OpenAI with unpublished math due to concerns about data use and intellectual property. Some fear unpublished work may influence future model updates. Trust remains uncertain.

items.title: OpenAI Agents API
items.author: aquir
items.summary: The Agents API by OpenAI manages agent infrastructure, provides tool calling, and supports multi-agent orchestration. It allows agents to operate in various environments and offers versioned access to new model capabilities. Pricing details are available on the official documentation.

items.title: Cognition launches new SWE-2 model, Rivaling Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra
items.author: seelos
items.summary: Cognition launched the SWE-2 model, rivaling Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra in performance and cost. It achieved high scores on coding benchmarks while being significantly cheaper.

items.title: Thelio Mira AI Linux Workstation: 192 GB GPU Memory
items.author: jonifico
items.summary: The Thelio Mira AI workstation features up to 192 GB of GPU memory using two RTX PRO 6000 GPUs. It is designed for local AI workloads and runs on Linux.

items.title: What happens when a GPU writes memory
items.author: ibobev
items.summary: When a GPU writes memory, it first updates the L2 cache, and later, the data is written to DRAM. The GPU uses DMA for direct memory access, and synchronization ensures CPU reads only after GPU writes are complete.

items.title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: September 2026
items.author: garo-pro
items.summary: In September 2026, Anthropic released a report detailing methods malicious actors use to exploit AI, and efforts to counter such misuse. The report follows a sophisticated cyber espionage campaign detected in September 2025. Anthropic aims to improve AI safety through ongoing threat intelligence.

items.title: Embedding a bitmap font in your HyperCard stack
items.author: zdw
items.summary: To embed a bitmap font in a HyperCard stack, add the font as a resource and use an XCMD to render it. Bitmap fonts can be larger than icons, enhancing visual customization. This method leverages the stack's resource capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI’s Navier-Stokes release included a Lean 4 formal proof
items.author: ibobev
items.summary: In 2026, OpenAI released a formal proof of a solution to the Navier-Stokes equations using Lean 4. The proof showed a fluid developing a singularity in finite time. The release included a 165-page analytical paper and a Lean repository.

items.title: YouTube had a bug – I used ChatGPT to investigate
items.author: theZilber
items.summary: Users reported issues with video upload and playback in a tool, likely related to a bug. The tool's developers are aware and working on a fix. For now, users are advised to wait for updates.

items.title: Cognition's SWE-2 achieves 92.8 on Terminal-Bench 2.1
items.author: cdnsteve
items.summary: Cognition's SWE-2 scored 92.8 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. This benchmark tests AI models on coding tasks. SWE-2's score is higher than most other models.

items.title: Compute-efficient pretraining and scaling to trillion-parameter models
items.author: ronfriedhaber
items.summary: Compute-efficient pretraining techniques reduce training costs and memory usage for large language models, enabling scaling to trillion-parameter models. AWS introduced MiCS with new augmentations for efficient training. Smaller models with better performance reduce carbon footprint.

items.title: Details.so
items.author: handfuloflight
items.summary: The YouTube video "So Many Details" by Toro y Moi was released in 2012. The AdSense issue indicates missing payment details for monetization. The current date is 2026-09-11.

items.title: AI Is Breaking This Thing We Call Trust
items.author: matheusml
items.summary: AI's complexity and deceptive capabilities are eroding public trust, leading to skepticism about authenticity and reliability. Trust issues are exacerbated by AI's ability to generate convincing but false content. Efforts to align AI with human intentions face significant challenges.

items.title: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash
items.author: Liwink
items.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a cost-efficient model with competitive performance, priced at $0.30 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens. It supports both text and image inputs, and has 763 billion parameters.

items.title: Macbeth and His Problems
items.author: apophatic
items.summary: Macbeth's problems stem from his ambition, moral conflict, and the supernatural influences that drive his actions. His internal struggle and eventual descent into tyranny highlight his tragic flaw.

items.title: How My Students Think About AI
items.author: paulpauper
items.summary: Students generally view AI as a tool for improving work quality and grades, but many feel unprepared for its use in future careers. They often see AI as less risky than portrayed, and some believe it could enhance learning if used thoughtfully.

items.title: On Next-Gen Transformer: Loops Are Not What You Need
items.author: matt_d
items.summary: Loops are not ideal for next-gen Transformers due to entanglement of addressing and content, and efficiency concerns. Residual injection rewrites both score and value, making loops unsuitable. Separating Q, K, V helps address these issues.
